vice_presidents.role_summary: Vice Presidents support the continuation and future success of Sutton Cricket Club through goodwill, attendance, advice, practical help and support within the local and cricketing communities. Appointment makes a Vice President an Honorary Member. New Vice Presidents are considered by the General Committee and confirmed at the next AGM, with appointments automatically renewed unless the Vice President requests otherwise.
vice_presidents.privacy_note: Contact details from historical membership records are not published.
